crossRefs.note: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”
“You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,
Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
and you will swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in…

translations.web: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”
translations.bsb: The servant asked him, “What if the woman is unwilling to follow me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the land from which you came?”
translations.kjv: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
translations.asv: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land. Must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
